zh: 前 K 根和其余花枝的分界由输入位置决定，与长度无关；两部分互不影响。
把数组按下标 K 切成两段，前段升序排序，后段降序排序，然后按原先的前后顺序拼接。
读入 n、n 个长度和 K（注意 n 可以为 0，K 也可以为 0 或 n）。对 [0,K) 升序排序，对 [K,n) 降序排序（或升序后倒序输出），用空格连接输出。
en: The split between the first K sticks and the rest is fixed by input position, not by length; the two parts do not affect each other.
Cut the array at index K, sort the first part ascending and the second part descending, then join them in their original order.
Read n, the n lengths and K (n may be 0, and K may be 0 or n). Sort [0,K) ascending and [K,n) descending (or ascending and printed in reverse), and print them separated by spaces.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Split the array at K, sort the two parts separately and join them in the required directions.

## Proof of correctness

The problem requires the first K items and the remaining items to be sorted separately, and the boundary between the parts is fixed by input position; sorting each part locally and joining them meets every requirement directly.

## Complexity

O(n log n) time, O(n) extra space.

## Source and additions

https://oamaster.com/docs/companies/hsbc#1-arrange-flower-sticks; the core of the original problem is clear but its constraints were damaged by OCR. This site adds n and the value ranges and fixes an obvious typo in the sample.
